newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 23.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunkers on Monday were unchanged from Friday's levels amid average enquiries, traders and brokers said. A major sold 2-3,000 tonnes of 380-cst at $119. Independents said 180-cst supplies were quoted between $122-$125. The market was quiet as Japan was on a holiday. MDO and gas oil were at $202-$208 with another major seen aggressive with an offer at $200. Gas oil were quoted unchanged at $218-$220.
